propositions: A rejected push on the async path produces detached stderr that is discarded by the OS, making git rejection reasons and backlog increments invisible to the caller.
The library and MCP paths install no stderr handler where tickets-branch writes log, causing push failures to go undelivered unless a handler is installed by the CLI.
The reconciler subprocess logs under rebar root while its handler targets rebar_reconciler, causing its push status to be mute.
A durable marker in the git dir records push failures with reason, state and backlog; it is recorded at the single _raise_if_strict choke point and cleared on successful push.
The async path polls the marker on a 60s deadline since the detached child is never waited; the library and MCP paths read status from the marker unconditionally.
A push that never reached COMMIT phase is recorded as pending with the phase reason, not only transport failures.
